product_one_liner.value: Rivo automates cash management for households by moving idle cash from their existing checking accounts into short-term U.S. Treasury bills and returning it before bills are due.
product_one_liner.notes: The FAQ explains that Autopilot moves unused cash into U.S. government-backed assets and returns it before bills are due, and says the service is designed for any household.

pricing_page.notes: The homepage’s visible calls to action and footer contain no pricing link; the public site offers no standalone pricing page in its navigation or footer.

named_customers.notes: The closest customer evidence is the homepage testimonial section, but its testimonials are anonymous and provide no customer names; therefore there are no names to list.

employee_band.notes: Business Wire reports 10–20 employees, which maps to the closest permitted band, 11–20. A LinkedIn profile separately reports 7 employees, so the exact band remains somewhat uncertain.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The company announcement directly gives the headquarters city as San Francisco. | hq_country: The company announcement identifies Rivo’s headquarters as San Francisco, United States.

founded_year.notes: The dated profile says Tyagi founded Rivo in 2025, directly grounding the year.

eng_blog.notes: The Rivo blog index displays a funding/public-launch announcement and no engineering or technical posts; it does not meet the requirement of two build-focused posts by engineers.

public_docs.notes: Rivo’s public Help Center lists multiple collections with dozens of articles, including Getting Started, Yield & Fees, and Safety & Security.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Rivo’s current careers board explicitly says “No jobs found,” so it has no open AI/ML/data-science role listed there.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: Rivo’s Trust Center names SOC 2 and CCPA under compliance; of the certifications requested, only SOC 2 is among the named options. | compliance_certs.0: The Trust Center explicitly names SOC 2 as a compliance item.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The company’s announcement identifies the $2.7 million latest round as a seed round. | funding_date: The funding profile dates the $2.7 million seed round to August 4, 2026, so the requested YYYY-MM value is 2026-08. | funding_amount_usd: Rivo’s announcement distinguishes $3.1 million in total funding from the most recent $2.7 million seed round; the requested amount is the round amount.

raised_18mo.notes: The dated company announcement reports the seed funding in September 2026, which falls within the 18 months preceding November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The current careers board explicitly reports no jobs, so there is no current SDR, BDR, or account-executive opening listed.

launched_6mo.notes: Rivo’s September 7, 2026 announcement says the company came out of beta and opened to the public, a launch within the six months before November 9, 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The current company careers board lists no jobs. The readable FAQ and Trust Center identify banking, custody, and security partners such as Plaid and Jiko, but do not identify a CRM or sales/marketing system used by Rivo.
